instructions_zh: 请回想过去一周，选择以下情况出现的频率。没有标准答案。

items.en: I was bothered by things that don't usually bother me.
items.zh_draft: 一些平时不会让我烦恼的事，也让我感到烦恼。

items.en: I had trouble keeping my mind on what I was doing.
items.zh_draft: 我很难集中注意力做正在做的事。

items.en: I felt that everything I did was an effort.
items.zh_draft: 我觉得做什么事都很费力。

items.en: I felt hopeful about the future.

scoring.direction: More frequent depressive symptoms during past week; not a diagnosis
scoring.critical_mapping: CMU interview PDF displays categories 1–4; official scoring page defines 0–3. Subtract 1 from display codes BEFORE reverse scoring. Never sum 1–4 directly.
scoring.missing: Require 10 valid responses for total; incomplete otherwise. This complete-case rule is an implementation safeguard, not a source-validated imputation rule. Do not score Don’t Know/Refused as zero.

threshold_evidence.population: Well older adults in a large health maintenance organization; exact N/age not verified from primary abstract
threshold_evidence.purpose: Agreement against full 20-item CES-D cutoff >=16, not standalone diagnostic confirmation
threshold_evidence.reference: Andresen EM, Malmgren JA, Carter WB, Patrick DL. Screening for depression in well older adults: evaluation of a short form of the CES-D. Am J Prev Med. 1994;10(2):77–84.
threshold_evidence.caution: Do not apply adult/older-adult thresholds to Chinese adolescents or assume teacher-specific validity.

threshold_evidence.population: 398 Chinese adults aged 60+ referred for psychiatric assessment
threshold_evidence.reference: Cheng ST, Chan ACM. The Center for Epidemiologic Studies Depression Scale in older Chinese: thresholds for long and short forms. Int J Geriatr Psychiatry. 2005.
threshold_evidence.verified_level: Primary abstract only; full translated item wording and sample selection require further review
threshold_evidence.caution: Do not confuse dichotomized CESD10 cutoff4 with 0–30 scoring. This does not validate our new translation.

report.heading: 最近一周，你过得怎么样？
report.body: 你的回答记录了过去一周情绪、睡眠、精力和孤独感方面的体验。这些体验可能随生活事件和身体状态变化，不能仅凭这份问卷判断你是否患有抑郁症。
report.next_steps: 可以先留意最常出现、最影响生活的困扰，找信任的人聊聊，尽量保持规律的作息。如果困扰持续、加重，或影响学习、工作和日常生活，可以寻求专业支持。
report.interpretation_policy: Default ordinary-reader feedback uses answered experiences, not unvalidated severity bands or technical scores. Technical raw score optional in details. No percentile/low-medium-high classification.
report.safety: This questionnaire does not ask about self-harm and cannot rule out urgent risk. If immediate safety concerns exist, seek nearby emergency assistance rather than relying on the score.

changes: Chinese items newly translated; not claimed to reproduce validated Chinese CESD10
